mask_objective.source: per-frame TrackRAD ground-truth masks from the training-40 split only
mask_objective.query_identity: inside or outside the target at each point's query frame
mask_objective.constraint: the tracked point should preserve that target-membership identity in every non-query frame
mask_objective.class_balance: inside and outside losses are averaged separately and then equally weighted
mask_objective.loss: binary cross entropy sampled differentiably at student coordinates and normalized to the bounded range [0,1]

training.resume_protocol: epoch/index-deterministic clip sampling plus global-step deterministic query/model randomness

selection.test_profiles: teacher-only control plus the best nonzero mask weight
